## QTD - Render Quote PDF
Called by the main workflow via Execute Sub-workflow. Pure function: quote data in, PDF binary out. Same swappable-engine architecture as Demo 1's CRG - Render Report PDF.

Option A: Self-hosted Gotenberg. No per-document cost, documents never leave your infrastructure. Requires Docker; works on self-hosted n8n only, not n8n Cloud. This is the default engine (Config.pdfEngine = gotenberg).

Option B: Hosted API (PDFShift). Works anywhere including n8n Cloud, no infrastructure to run. Per-document cost (free tier: 50 documents per month, no card required, then paid). Switch by setting Config.pdfEngine to api. Authenticated via an httpHeaderAuth credential (header name X-API-Key), never a hardcoded key.

STATUS: built and configured, but not credentialed or live-tested in this reference instance.

Two failure layers: (1) if the credential is entirely missing/unbound, n8n rejects the run before this node executes at all -- QTD - Error Alert detects that specific case and rewrites the alert into a plain-language message telling you to add the credential. (2) if a credential IS configured but the call still fails, that is a normal node error, caught here by Format PDFShift Failure / Fail - PDF API Engine Error.
